answer.says: You are right, Shri Hegde. The procedure is the procedure, and I am merely a guest in it. I will go and eat my raita.
answer.thought: He is a man of the form, a creature of the administrative machinery who finds comfort in the routine of the file. He does not understand that for me, this bungalow is not just a roof, but a site of ethical contradiction, yet his practical advice to eat the raita is the only thing that is currently real. The haze outside is thick, and the air is bad, but the food is here.
